purpose: Verify Super Admin can successfully create a basic user account of type Student, Faculty, or Staff.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Submit valid user creation request with user_type='Student', name='John Doe', email='john@iiitdmj.ac.in', institute_id='2026001', department='CSE'.
expected_result: Basic user account is created successfully.

purpose: Verify system captures all required profile fields upon user creation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Create user providing user_type, name, institute_email, contact_number, institute_id, department, date_of_joining, and expected_completion_date.
expected_result: All provided profile fields are captured and saved accurately.

purpose: Verify positive unique Institute ID validation during user creation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active. Institute ID '2026002' does not exist.
action_or_input: Submit user creation request with institute_id='2026002'.
expected_result: Account creation succeeds.

purpose: Verify rejection of user creation when Institute ID is non-unique.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active. User with Institute ID '2026001' already exists.
action_or_input: Submit user creation request with institute_id='2026001'.
expected_result: Account creation is rejected with a uniqueness violation error.

purpose: Verify Institute ID cannot be changed after account creation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active. User account exists with institute_id='2026001'.
action_or_input: Submit profile update request attempting to change institute_id from '2026001' to '2026099'.
expected_result: Update request is rejected or institute_id remains unchanged ('2026001').

purpose: Verify positive acceptance of valid institute email address.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Submit user creation request with email='user@iiitdmj.ac.in'.
expected_result: Email address is accepted and account creation succeeds.

purpose: Verify rejection of non-institute email address.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Submit user creation request with email='user@gmail.com'.
expected_result: Account creation is rejected due to invalid institute email address.

purpose: Verify duplicate user creation prevention via identity data validation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active. Existing user with identical identity details.
action_or_input: Submit creation request matching existing user identity data.
expected_result: System detects duplicate identity data and rejects user creation.

purpose: Verify unique internal user ID generation upon creation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Create a new basic user account.
expected_result: System automatically generates a unique internal user ID for the created account.

purpose: Verify initial login credentials generation upon creation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Create a new basic user account.
expected_result: Initial login credentials are securely generated for the user.

purpose: Verify basic-user dashboard access is enabled upon account creation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Create a basic user account and attempt basic dashboard authentication/access.
expected_result: Newly created user is provisioned with baseline dashboard access.

purpose: Verify sending of welcome message with credential information and first-login guidance.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Create a basic user account.
expected_result: Welcome message containing initial credentials, first-login instructions, profile update link, and password change link is sent to user email.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can view complete permitted basic user profile.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; basic user exists.
action_or_input: Request basic user profile view for targeted user ID.
expected_result: Permitted complete basic user profile data is displayed.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can update editable basic user profile information.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; basic user exists.
action_or_input: Update user contact number and department while preserving Institute ID.
expected_result: Editable profile fields are updated successfully.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can deactivate an active user account.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; active user account exists.
action_or_input: Execute account deactivation on targeted user.
expected_result: User account status transitions to deactivated.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can reactivate a deactivated user account when policy permits.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; deactivated user account exists within policy limits.
action_or_input: Execute account reactivation on deactivated user.
expected_result: User account status transitions back to active.

purpose: Verify maintenance of audit trail for user profile and status changes.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; user profile/status updated.
action_or_input: Perform profile update or deactivation on a user.
expected_result: Audit entry recording timestamp, reason/context, and status history is recorded.

purpose: Verify bulk user batch creation from valid predefined CSV template.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; valid CSV file prepared.
action_or_input: Upload predefined CSV file containing valid user creation records.
expected_result: All users in CSV batch are created successfully.

purpose: Verify bulk deactivation of multiple users in one operation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; multiple active users exist.
action_or_input: Submit bulk deactivation request with list of target user IDs.
expected_result: Targeted user accounts are deactivated in bulk.

purpose: Verify permitted bulk status updates on multiple users.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; target users exist.
action_or_input: Submit bulk status update request for multiple users.
expected_result: Permitted status updates are applied across targeted users.

purpose: Verify pre-validation of bulk template structure and operation-size constraints.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Upload bulk operation CSV file with invalid header structure.
expected_result: System rejects processing before execution and flags structural template error.

action_or_input: Submit CSV file with mixed valid and invalid records.
expected_result: System identifies invalid record and isolates error prior to final commit.

purpose: Verify production of accurate success/failure summary for bulk user operation.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; bulk operation executed.
action_or_input: Execute bulk user operation with mixed record outcomes.
expected_result: System generates an accurate summary reporting count of succeeded and failed records.

purpose: Verify production of detailed processing log with per-record outcomes.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; bulk operation completed.
action_or_input: Request processing log for executed bulk operation.
expected_result: Detailed processing log listing itemized outcome per record is generated.

purpose: Verify Super Admin notification upon bulk user operation completion.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Complete bulk user operation.
expected_result: Notification is delivered to Super Admin indicating bulk operation completion.

purpose: Verify read-only inspection of role definitions and metadata.

expected_result: Role name, description, module/department association, eligibility, singularity, default validity, permissions, and compatibility rules are presented read-only.

purpose: Verify assignment of additional role specifying required parameters.

action_or_input: Assign role specifying target_user, role_id, start_date, end_date, scope, and reason.
expected_result: Additional role is assigned to the target user with specified parameters.

purpose: Verify support for holding multiple non-conflicting roles simultaneously.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; user already holds Role A.
action_or_input: Assign additional compatible Role B to the same user.
expected_result: Role B is assigned; user successfully holds both Role A and Role B simultaneously.

purpose: Verify positive assignment of a singular role when no active holder exists.

action_or_input: Assign singular role to User 1.
expected_result: Singular role assignment succeeds.

purpose: Verify prevention of assigning a singular role when an active holder already exists.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; User 1 currently holds active singular role for scope.

expected_result: Assignment is rejected due to singularity constraint violation.

purpose: Verify validation of role compatibility with target user's basic user type.

action_or_input: Assign Faculty-only role to Student user.
expected_result: System rejects assignment due to user-type eligibility mismatch.

purpose: Verify check of configured role conflicts prior to assignment.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; target user holds Role A; Role B conflicts with Role A.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign Role B to target user.
expected_result: System detects role conflict and rejects assignment.

purpose: Verify automatic activation of future-dated role assignment on start date.
preconditions: Future-dated role assignment exists for user; system clock reaches start date.
action_or_input: Trigger automated scheduled task on role start date.
expected_result: Role assignment automatically transitions from pending to active.

purpose: Verify automatic inactivation of time-bound role on end date.
preconditions: Time-bound active role reaches its configured end date.
action_or_input: Trigger automated end-date scheduled task.
expected_result: Role status transitions to inactive automatically.

purpose: Verify affected user notification upon role assignment.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Assign role to basic user.
expected_result: Notification is delivered to affected user regarding role assignment.

purpose: Verify exposure of assigned roles on user dashboard for role selection.
preconditions: User possesses multiple active assigned roles.
action_or_input: User logs into system dashboard.
expected_result: All valid assigned roles are displayed on user dashboard interface.

purpose: Verify audit trail and history recording of role assignment.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active.
action_or_input: Assign role to basic user.
expected_result: Role assignment is logged in audit trail and recorded in role assignment history.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can reassign an existing role to a new user.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; active role holder exists; eligible replacement user exists.
action_or_input: Submit role reassignment with new_user, effective_date, and reason.
expected_result: Role reassignment request is accepted and scheduled/processed.

purpose: Verify handover of access on effective date of role reassignment.
preconditions: Reassignment effective date is reached.
action_or_input: Execute reassignment effective-date transition.
expected_result: Role access is revoked from previous holder and granted to new holder.

purpose: Verify transfer of pending tasks to new holder on reassignment without exposing content to Super Admin.
preconditions: Previous holder has pending role-specific tasks.
action_or_input: Process role reassignment.
expected_result: Pending tasks transfer to new holder via system services without exposing task operational details to Super Admin.

purpose: Verify notification to previous and new role holders on role reassignment.
preconditions: Role reassignment executed.
action_or_input: Trigger role reassignment processing.
expected_result: Notifications are delivered to both previous and new role holders.

purpose: Verify retention of complete role-reassignment history.
preconditions: Role reassignment completed.
action_or_input: Inspect system role history logs.
expected_result: Complete reassignment trace including dates, reason, old holder, and new holder is preserved.

purpose: Verify previous holder read-only access to prior actions during audit period.
preconditions: Role reassigned; current time within configured audit access period.
action_or_input: Previous holder attempts to view historical actions performed during prior role tenure.
expected_result: Read-only access to prior actions is granted to previous holder.

purpose: Verify previous holder audit access expires after audit period.
preconditions: Role reassigned; configured audit access period has expired.
action_or_input: Previous holder attempts to access prior role action records.
expected_result: Read-only access is denied.

purpose: Verify emergency reassignment with immediate effect.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; active role holder exists.
action_or_input: Execute emergency reassignment with immediate effective timestamp.
expected_result: Role access transfers to new holder immediately without notice delay.

purpose: Verify early role revocation specifying mandatory reason and task disposition.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; active user role exists.
action_or_input: Submit role revocation with revocation_date, mandatory reason, and pending task disposition ('transfer').
expected_result: Role revocation is submitted successfully.

purpose: Verify rejection of role revocation without mandatory reason.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; active user role exists.
action_or_input: Submit role revocation omitting mandatory reason.
expected_result: Revocation request is rejected with validation error.

purpose: Verify removal of role access on effective revocation date.
preconditions: Effective revocation date reached.
action_or_input: Process effective revocation state transition.
expected_result: Target user's role access is completely removed.

purpose: Verify pending tasks handled according to specified transfer-or-close disposition upon revocation.
preconditions: Revoked role holder has pending tasks; disposition set to 'close'.
action_or_input: Execute role revocation.
expected_result: Pending tasks associated with revoked role are closed as per specified disposition.

purpose: Verify notification to affected user and relevant module administrators upon revocation.
preconditions: Role revocation executed.
action_or_input: Trigger role revocation process.
expected_result: Notifications sent to affected user and module administrators.

purpose: Verify revocation is recorded in audit trail.
preconditions: Role revocation executed.
action_or_input: Inspect system audit logs.
expected_result: Audit trail contains complete entry for role revocation event.

purpose: Verify automatic role inactivation when scheduled end date is reached.
preconditions: Role end date reached.
action_or_input: Trigger scheduled expiry system check.
expected_result: Time-bound role is automatically revoked/inactivated.

purpose: Verify automatic revocation of assigned roles when user account is deactivated.
preconditions: Active user holds assigned roles; Super Admin deactivates user account.
action_or_input: Deactivate basic user account.
expected_result: All assigned roles belonging to user are automatically revoked/inactivated.

purpose: Verify tracking of role validity periods and identification of roles approaching expiration.
preconditions: Role validity date within configured lead time window.
action_or_input: Run role validity tracking check.
expected_result: Roles approaching expiration are identified accurately.

purpose: Verify role-expiry reminders sent at configured lead time.
preconditions: Role expiry date matches lead time trigger.
action_or_input: Execute notification reminder job.
expected_result: Role-expiry reminders delivered to Super Admin and affected user.

purpose: Verify extension of time-bound role validity prior to expiration.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; unexpired time-bound role exists.
action_or_input: Submit role extension with new end date and reason.
expected_result: Role end date is updated and validity extended.

purpose: Verify affected user notification upon role validity extension.
preconditions: Super Admin extends role validity.
action_or_input: Execute role extension.
expected_result: Notification delivered to affected user confirming role extension.

purpose: Verify affected user notification when time-bound role expires.
preconditions: Time-bound role reaches end date and expires.
action_or_input: Trigger role expiration system task.
expected_result: Notification delivered to affected user announcing role expiration.

purpose: Verify multi-role user can view assigned roles and switch active role for session.
preconditions: Logged-in user holds Role A and Role B.
action_or_input: User selects Role B as active role for session.
expected_result: Session active role updates to Role B.

purpose: Verify module access granted according to active role permissions.
preconditions: User switched active role to Role B (has Module X access, no Module Y access).
action_or_input: Attempt access to Module X.
expected_result: Access to Module X is granted.

purpose: Verify module access denied when active role lacks required permissions.
preconditions: User active role is Role B (lacks Module Y access).
action_or_input: Attempt access to Module Y.
expected_result: Access to Module Y is denied.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can archive an eligible inactive user.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; eligible deactivated user exists.
action_or_input: Submit archival request with archival_date, reason, and retention option.
expected_result: User archival process initiates successfully.

purpose: Verify user archival allowed after minimum deactivation interval and pending constraint satisfaction.
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; user deactivated > minimum interval, no pending transactions.
action_or_input: Archive eligible user account.
expected_result: Archival request is accepted.

preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin session active; user deactivated < minimum required interval.
action_or_input: Attempt to archive user account.
expected_result: Archival request rejected due to policy interval non-compliance.

purpose: Verify user credentials/access disabled and roles revoked upon archival.
preconditions: User account archival executed.
action_or_input: Attempt login or role access with archived user credentials.
expected_result: Credentials disabled, all system access denied, assigned roles revoked.

purpose: Verify archived record retains profile, role history, module participation, and audit trail.

action_or_input: Retrieve archived record data structure.

expected_result: Archived user account is restored to deactivated/active state.

purpose: Verify rejection of restoration attempt when required authorization is missing.
preconditions: Super Admin session active; user within reversible period; required authorization missing.
action_or_input: Submit user restore request.
expected_result: Restoration request rejected due to missing authorization.

preconditions: User account archived; reversible window expired (ISS-SA-004).

purpose: Verify Super Admin can initiate historical system data archival by category and date range.

purpose: Verify backup creation prior to moving historical data to archive database.

purpose: Verify moving eligible historical data to archive database after successful archival.

purpose: Verify generation of archival summary report after historical data archival.

expected_result: Archival summary report detailing processed counts and metrics is generated.

purpose: Verify read-only searchable access to permitted archived records subject to data isolation.

purpose: Verify rejection of historical data restoration without required approval.

purpose: Verify search and filter options for archived users and records.

purpose: Verify generation of archive reports from permitted archived data.

purpose: Verify export of archived data packages for external storage.
